findings.claim: Refitting a free-area exponential law on the development cohorts improves transfer to the reserved multidirectional conditions over the published source law and matched flexible control.
findings.equation: v_hat=v0[1-exp(-k max(eta-a,0))], eta in m²/person, v0 in m/s, k in persons/m² and a in m²/person.
findings.evidence: Development-selected model MAE0.28514m/s on the two reserved condition panels; published-source0.24194 and flexible0.27568 are better.
findings.known_prior_art: The source paper already publishes this exponential model family and three crowd-density regimes.
findings.falsification: The proposed improvement fails confirmation; signed bias+0.27346m/s indicates strong overprediction.
findings.scope: Processed figure tables with missing run/person IDs; within-source condition transfer only.

findings.claim: Speed-density laws fitted across the available uni/counterflow cohorts remain condition-sensitive when transferred to the linked multidirectional family.
findings.equation: Greenshields exclusion, Underwood slowdown, free-area exponential, distance-headway and two-regime exclusion models are preserved.
findings.evidence: Five substantive attempts; best development model does not beat the exposed source law on confirmation and has worst-condition MAE0.40587m/s.
findings.known_prior_art: Flow direction and geometry dependence are established concerns; the source already analyzes regime differences.
findings.falsification: Missing original run identifiers and different measurement protocols prevent attribution of failure to direction alone.
findings.scope: No individual-level independence, safe capacity threshold or new universal crowd law.

findings.claim: This task discovers a new physical crowd law or demonstrates improved evacuation safety.
findings.evidence: No intervention, evacuation outcome or independent population study is included; even the selected transfer improvement fails.
findings.known_prior_art: The known source relationship is disclosed and used as a comparator.
findings.falsification: Source figure ordinates are insufficient to identify the proposed causal or operational claim.

scientific_adjudication: Agent-assisted analysis; not independent experimental replication or human expert adjudication.
